title: Dual Realm Deity
description: A split composition artwork shows a multi-armed crowned deity with a skull-like face and mechanical elements, seated atop a mound of skulls and figures on the left white side. The right black side depicts a silhouetted horned figure atop a similar skull mound, surrounded by glowing celestial rings, stars, insects, and ghostly figures below.
